overall: As of 10:50 ET, NYC is at 75.9°F with a slow warming trend (+0.9°F/hr velocity, +0.5°F/hr over 2h), still roughly 7°F below the NWS forecast high of ~83°F. forecast_obs_notes: There is a stark split between the NWP models (GFS 88.4°F, ECMWF 90.9°F, HRRR 91.7°F) and the intraday observations: current warming pace from observed data projects a peak well below those model guidance values.
